commands: set -eu; RD="$HOME/recordings/solution/.recorder"; mkdir -p "$RD"; rm -rf "$RD/recorder"; cp scripts/record-item.mjs "$RD/record-item.mjs"; cp -r scripts/recorder "$RD/recorder"; export npm_config_cache="$RD/npm-cache" PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH="$RD/browsers"; npm --prefix "$RD/recorder" ci --no-audit --no-fund; node "$RD/recorder/node_modules/playwright/cli.js" install chromium; echo "recorder installed: $RD"

set -eu; RD="$HOME/recordings/solution/.recorder"; export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH="$RD/browsers"; : "${PLAN_ITEM:?set PLAN_ITEM to the Plan target id}"; : "${TASK_ITEM:?set TASK_ITEM to the Task target id}"; command -v ffmpeg ffprobe; test -r /etc/horizon/recorder.env && echo "token file readable"; node -e 'require("fs").accessSync(require(process.argv[1]).chromium.executablePath()); console.log("chromium ok")' "$RD/recorder/node_modules/playwright"; for d in 4-plan 4-task; do dir="$HOME/recordings/solution/raw/$d"; if [ -e "$dir" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$dir")" ]; then echo "FAIL not empty: $dir"; exit 1; fi; echo "empty: $dir"; done; HORIZON_RECORDER_ENV=/etc/horizon/recorder.env node --input-type=module -e 'import { readToken } from "./scripts/recorder/token.mjs"; import { pollItem } from "./scripts/recorder/watch.mjs"; const token = await readToken(); for (const [id, first] of [[process.env.PLAN_ITEM, "Define the question"], [process.env.TASK_ITEM, "Define the outcome"]]) { const s = await pollItem({ apiBase: "https://shoreward.ai/horizon/api", itemId: id, token }); if (!s) { console.log("FAIL not on board: " + id); process.exit(3) } console.log("target " + id + ": cursor=" + s.cursor + " step=" + s.label); if (s.done || s.label !== first) { console.log("FAIL " + id + " is past its first step"); process.exit(1) } } console.log("preflight ok")'

set -u; R="$HOME/recordings/solution"; RD="$R/.recorder"; export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH="$RD/browsers"; mkdir -p "$R/raw/4-plan" "$R/raw/4-task" "$R/logs"; export HORIZON_RECORDER_ENV=/etc/horizon/recorder.env; timeout -k 60 1420m node "$RD/record-item.mjs" "$PLAN_ITEM" --out "$R/raw/4-plan" > "$R/logs/4-plan.log" 2>&1 & P=$!; timeout -k 60 1420m node "$RD/record-item.mjs" "$TASK_ITEM" --out "$R/raw/4-task" > "$R/logs/4-task.log" 2>&1 & T=$!; echo "started 4-plan pid=$P item=$PLAN_ITEM; 4-task pid=$T item=$TASK_ITEM"; wait "$P"; PE=$?; wait "$T"; TE=$?; for d in 4-plan 4-task; do echo "--- $R/logs/$d.log"; cat "$R/logs/$d.log"; done; echo "run 4-plan item=$PLAN_ITEM exit=$PE log=$R/logs/4-plan.log"; echo "run 4-task item=$TASK_ITEM exit=$TE log=$R/logs/4-task.log"; F=0; [ "$PE" -eq 0 ] || F=$((F+1)); [ "$TE" -eq 0 ] || F=$((F+1)); echo "failed runs: $F"; [ "$F" -eq 0 ]

set -u; R="$HOME/recordings/solution"; bad=0; check() { d="$1"; id="$2"; first="$3"; dir="$R/raw/$d"; echo "== $d ($id)"; got=$(ls -A "$dir" | sort | tr '
' ' '); want=$(printf '%s
' "$id.mp4" frames timeline.json | sort | tr '
' ' '); echo "contents: $got"; [ "$got" = "$want" ] || { echo "FAIL contents: $d"; bad=1; }; n=$(ls "$dir/frames" | grep -cE '^[0-9]+[.]png$'); echo "numbered frames: $n"; [ "$n" -gt 0 ] || { echo "FAIL no frames: $d"; bad=1; }; dur=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=nw=1:nk=1 "$dir/$id.mp4"); echo "ffprobe duration: ${dur:-none} s"; awk -v x="${dur:-0}" 'BEGIN{exit !(x>0)}' || { echo "FAIL duration: $d"; bad=1; }; node -e 'const t = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8")); const f = t[0], l = t[t.length - 1]; console.log("timeline: " + t.length + " entries; first=" + f.step + " @ " + f.realStart + "; last=" + l.step + " @ " + l.realEnd); if (f.step !== process.argv[2]) { console.log("FAIL first step: want " + process.argv[2]); process.exit(1) } if (l.step !== "Review & close") { console.log("FAIL last step: want Review & close"); process.exit(1) }' "$dir/timeline.json" "$first" || bad=1; grep -qx "closed: $id" "$R/logs/$d.log" && echo "ended: closed: $id" || { echo "FAIL not closed: $d"; bad=1; }; ls "$dir/frames" | grep -E '^[0-9]+[.]png$' | sort | awk -v p="$dir/frames/" '{a[NR]=$0} END{if(NR) print "spot check: " p a[1] " " p a[int((NR+1)/2)] " " p a[NR]}'; }; check 4-plan "$PLAN_ITEM" "Define the question"; check 4-task "$TASK_ITEM" "Define the outcome"; if [ "$bad" -eq 0 ]; then echo "verify: PASS"; else echo "verify: FAIL"; fi; exit "$bad"
